title: Lab - Kustomize transformers
description: Transform a whole set of manifests at once.
scenario: Transform a whole set of manifests at once. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Labels
tasks.instructions: Add commonLabels org=KodeKloud to everything in the project.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Namespace
tasks.instructions: Place everything under the db directory into namespace db-ns.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Image
tasks.instructions: Change the nginx image to nginx:1.23 everywhere.
